# τ chosen on the previous window and applied to the next (generated by code/prospective_tau.py)

Design fixed beforehand: 07_paper_draft/phase5_workflow.md, section 8. fill = realised fill in the target window; inv = inventory in weeks of demand; Δ vs LGB-Q (fill in points, inventory in %). 'ex-post Δ inv' = inventory at equal realised fill in the target window (the paper's metric), for comparison.
